The plan's own Step 1 expectation (`1510 → '01:10:00'`) has the same defect. The spec is the binding authority, so I rule for the spec and keep going. def format_time(minutes: int) -> str:
    """Format minutes since the start of the service day as HH:MM:SS.

    Hours are not wrapped: a stop at 01:10 the next morning is "25:10:00".
    """
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}:00"
</edit>
